_meta.slot_divergences: T5 PREDATES THE SLOT SCHEMA. Tekken 5 (PS2, 2004) introduced character customization, but its data does NOT use the T6 4-slot / T7 16-slot item-slot system: in TK5DATA1.BIN each character pack (19-entry archive) carries exactly ONE costume model (sub02, full body incl. head/hair/props as a single NUDP) + ONE low-poly full-body model (sub05) + TIM2 textures (sub01). NO per-slot item meshes (no separate HEAD/UPPER/LOWER/HAIR_ACC NUDP entries) exist in any of the 80 packs — verified by full NUDP census (464 occurrences classified) and own-eyes renders. Per-slot item data, if present in this build at all, can only live in (a) the 9 ctype-5 containers whose models use the undecoded VIF 0x82 vertex format, or (b) TK5DATA0.BIN, which remains encrypted under a second cipher layer and is the suspected home of the content for DATA1's 216 empty table slots. Mapping T5 content onto the registry shape therefore happens at FULL_BODY (whole-costume) granularity at conversion time, and any finer slot claim would be invented — it is NOT made here.

named_gaps.acquisition: DONE — gap-closure W7d (2026-10-21), see T5-CTYPE5-DECODE-2026-10-21.md. Route taken: the survey's byte-budget solve. All 9 containers reproduced from release tekken5-disc-v1 by HTTP Range and verified DECRYPT-MATCH against the E5 word-sum checksum table; the 0x82 packet layout was solved from the smallest model (file 0753) and then proven on all 238 VIF blobs of all 16 models (every blob consumed to exactly its size field; every section's element count equals the packet's own vertCount; all face indices in range; positions finite). Layout: positions V3-32 @VU1, vertex colors V4-8 @VU3, UVs V2-32 @VU4, tristrip markers as in the 0x91 form; NO normals, NO weights, NO bone indices. Decoded geometry was rendered (proof/ctype5-*.png) and classified from the renders + measurements only.
named_gaps.expected_source: 9 ctype-5 containers in TK5DATA1.BIN: [u32 count=5][subs: TIM2 set, NUDP set (VIF globalFlags 0x82), MIF, small data, data]. 16 NUDP models total (1,520-19,264 B) = 8 unique geometries (twin containers hold byte-identical models). Decoded verdict: environment/effect-class geometry — repeated triangular-prism beam units (150x173.2 section, 2500 long), concentric-ring effect discs (diameter 2000), one tall open cylindrical tube (diameter ~1996, height ~3972) — at scene scale with a shared white alpha-gradient texture (file 0753's model carries a dark metallic panel texture instead). NO per-slot item meshes and no head/skull/mask geometry among them. (The 'head portrait' characterization of the 1061 pair that circulated earlier was another lane's T6 finding, not T5 evidence — it is not repeated here; the decoded 1061 models are a flat panel and a prism-beam unit.)
